d:
Hey all! Chapter 1 of Runaway prince is available! In this chapter, I introduce Prince Eadwig, who lives a life of luxury. He's living a sort of monotonous life bedding various women. Unfortunately for him, the galaxy is in civil war and the emperor's descendents are being targeted and killed. So that the rebel faction can kill the emperor and be free. Prince Eadwig somehow miraculously survives to be the very last living descendent. In surviving, he's rushed through Royal School 101, and is surrounded by guards who seem to die daily in battles with assassins. He can't take it anymore and flees with one of his callgirls (named Silvie). She's vaporized (or is she) and Prince Eadwig is forced to play the part of a young callgirl earning the trust of her new gang.

In the original script, I had way more furry content. Not sure if you all are into it, but I figured a sci-fi world was the purrfect setting for more believable furry stuff. I might open it up to more of that later on, but we'll see.

Do you want more furry content? Or just the gender bend?

I'm so excited for this story to really kick off. I want this story to progress quicker through the gender change (with the help of a magic remote). This is 20 of 47 pages, with 13 NSFW pages. The rest you can read on my Patreon. The NSFW ones are there! Enjoy!

Also, I have a special video just for my subscribers for the NSFW end scene of this chapter!
